movement_source: row 'Net interest margin (%)', column Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 -> column Full Year Ended 30 Jun 25
headline: CBA's Group net interest margin rose 9 bpts in FY25 to 2.08%, from 1.99% in FY24 (ev-3, ev-13). The results book's NIM walk (page 28) attributes the +9 bpts to: Liquids & Pooled Facilities +7 bpts, Capital, Replicating and Other +9 bpts, Treasury and Markets +1 bpt, partly offset by Funding costs -7 bpts and Basis risk -1 bpt; Asset pricing and Portfolio mix were flat (0). Excluding the +7 bpts from lower liquid assets and institutional pooled facilities (broadly neutral to NII), the underlying margin rose 2 bpts (ev-4, ev-13). The FY24 profit announcement corroborates the FY24 level of 1.99% (ev-12). The walk's bars sum to +9 bpts, matching the movement with no residual.

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Reduction in lower yielding liquid assets drove a 5 bpt increase and institutional pooled lending facilities a 2 bpt increase in margin. The bank notes this is broadly neutral to net interest income (ev-7, ev-4).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: The bank states asset pricing was flat, contributing nothing to the margin movement (ev-6).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Funding costs decreased margin by 7 bpts, driven by increased deposit price competition (ev-5). The highlights page confirms the offsetting impact of increased competition on deposit pricing (ev-14).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: The bank states portfolio mix was flat, contributing nothing to the margin movement (ev-11).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Basis risk arises from the spread between the 3 month bank bill swap rate and the 3 month overnight index swap rate; margin decreased 1 bpt reflecting an increase in the average spread (ev-8).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Increased margin by 9 bpts: net impact of the replicating portfolio due to changes in portfolio rate and volume (up 5 bpts) and higher earnings on capital hedges (up 4 bpts) (ev-9).

drivers.columns: Full Year Ended 30 Jun 24 to 30 Jun 25
drivers.narrative: Treasury and Markets increased margin by 1 basis point (ev-10).

limitations: The primary walk (page 28 of the FY25 profit announcement) is the task comparison FY24→FY25 and its bars sum to +9 bpts, matching the movement; no residual.
The FY24 results presentation (page 28) and FY24 profit announcement describe FY24 vs FY23 or half-on-half comparisons, which are context only and were not used for driver contributions.
The Group NIM row carries no cash/statutory label; it is reported on the bank's primary (cash) basis per the continuing-operations presentation, and is not called statutory.
The bank qualifies the +7 bpts Liquids & Pooled Facilities bar as broadly neutral to net interest income; the underlying (ex-liquids & pooled facilities) margin rose only 2 bpts.
Capped at 80: asset_pricing +0 bps, mix +0 bps. The records these claims cite do not state those numbers, so each one is arithmetic over the evidence rather than a figure read from it.

evidence_records.quote: [walk chart] NIM Movement since June 2024: Jun 24 Full Year 199 -> Jun 25 Full Year 208

The Bank's net interest margin increased 9 basis points on the prior year to 2.08%. Excluding a 7 basis point increase in margin from a reduction in lower yielding liquid assets and institutional pooled facilities, which have a broadly neutral impact on net interest income, net interest margin increased 2 basis points.

numbers.label: NIM excl liquids & pooled facilities increase

evidence_records.quote: Funding costs: Decreased margin by 7 basis points driven by increased deposit price competition.
Reduction in lower yielding liquid assets and institutional pooled lending facilities drove a 5 basis point and 2 basis point increase in margin respectively.

Basis risk: Basis risk arises from the spread between the 3 month bank bill swap rate and the 3 month overnight index swap rate. The Bank's margin decreased 1 basis point reflecting an increase in the average spread.

Capital, Replicating and Other: Increased margin by 9 basis points driven by the net impact of the replicating portfolio due to changes in portfolio rate and volume (up 5 basis points) and higher earnings on capital hedges (up 4 basis points).

numbers.label: Capital, Replicating and Other NIM impact
